verdict.rationale: Alacritty is a local, open-source terminal emulator that is installed and run on the user's own machine (BSD, Linux, macOS, Windows) and configured through local TOML files. The evidence shows no hosted service, accounts or cloud storage, so choosing a storage region or data residency is not an applicable axis for this product. Nothing in the pack suggests it ships any server-side storage that would make the question applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
